payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.8 — big release.

Native RDP in-canvas (no Docker): renders inside SecureSH, resizes, clipboard, usable resolution; fixed stuck modifiers (keyboard/cursor/Properties) and black non-primary monitors.

Remote Desktop (no-admin) is now a native streamer with a WebRTC -> H.264/NVENC -> JPEG fallback ladder: dirty-rectangle tiling (much lower bandwidth), hardware H.264 via WebCodecs, full WebRTC video + system audio (Opus) + input over a data channel.

Security: master-password prompt on startup, change master password, 'ask on every connection', 'remember on this device' (app only); settable/stable web-server token so the URL stops rotating.

Vault auto-prompt on connect; self-updater.
